description: This file implements the code-behind logic for the ExamResult web page in an online examination system. It handles session data retrieval, updates user exam statistics in the database, and populates UI controls with exam results and related information.

classes.name: ExamResult
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ExamResult.aspx page, managing the display and update of exam results, user statistics, and navigation controls.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves session data, updates user statistics in the database, and populates UI controls with exam data.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'Home' button is clicked; navigates to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'Profile' button is clicked; navigates to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'Leaderboard' button is clicked; navigates to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'Logout' button is clicked; navigates to the login page.
